title: Nice Theme
text: Nice Theme. I am obsessed with decorating tiered trays. I have at least 2 different trays set up at a time. This is a nice theme. I don't think I have seen gingerbread themed ones before. I especially like the gnome and the beads. the blocks look mass produced. By that, I mean they are kind of flat and too perfect. They don't have the hand painted look to them. Overall, this is a fun set for the holidays.
